rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -E '2026-|caught live|compounded|MOVED' body = zero hits; no session-date or year markers in body prose

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Register match.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Rough-cut drafts for articles.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Rule applies to articles only; this is an exercise, not an article draft.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Credit original when paraphrasing named technique.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Always "you", never "the student"; teacher framing stays out of body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle terms of art from maintainer into body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Key terms earned inline: verifier at line 15, three shapes at 66-68 with descriptions, reference and plan.md at 85-88. All load-bearing terms have earning moments.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Over-hedge detector.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No reassurance-shaped sentences found. Delegation to Claude stated factually without appended absolution.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Verbatim-frame-cite in reference artefact.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Rule applies to reference artifacts; this discusses what a reference is but does not contain one in student-facing body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cap practitioner attribution at one student-side mention per module.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Ralph named once at line 123. No other practitioners named. Attribution cap not exceeded.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Punchy framing keeps punch; carve-out lives downstream.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 19 opening is punchy. Complexity lands downstream at 50-51 and 64-68. Framing stands, carve-out is structural.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Value-prop / positioning framing belongs in sales copy + project strategy docs, NOT student-facing curriculum body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No value-prop leak phrases. Teaching follows concrete mechanisms, not defensive positioning.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Watch out for planting jargon too early.
rules_evaluated.evidence: M5 exercise. Key terms earned inline before use. No LLM-internal vocabulary planted without explanation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Audit closer when trimming body-prose forcing function.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No body-prose forcing functions trimmed; exercise structure preserves all operative instructions.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: The **What happened:** block is OPTIONAL.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Exercise correctly omits optional recap section, ending on final move.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No combative verbs about the agent in body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Verbs are peer-flat: ask, send, show, push back. No combative verbs. Fire at line 79 means activate, not combat.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Headers must be literally true about the mechanism.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Headers literally describe phase mechanics. No metaphors contradict mechanism. No ungrounded other-X presuppositions.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Machine-cadence fat — the shape of good prose without the content.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No empty negations, deictic drumroll, or bold-label echo. Bold definitions at 66-68 define, not echo. Prose is lean.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't state a count the adjacent list already holds.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Counts are used as recall scaffolding, not adjacent to lists. Phases use structural headers, not count-in-prose.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A slogan that is false as stated is not punchy framing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 19 slogan holds across exercise. Every phase builds packaging from diagnosed failure. Statement survives falsifiability test.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A claim binds to every body that states it.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Single-file evaluation; cross-file rule does not apply.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A rule set reconstructed at session start goes stale inside the session.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Meta-rule about audit methodology, not a prose-evaluation rule.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Aspirational destination, never corrective gap.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lines 15-19 name aspirational destination. No corrective gap framing.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Earn every technical term on first use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Terms earned inline: worktree (line 7), transcript (line 28), verifier (lines 50-51), reference/plan.md (lines 85-88). No cold terms.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Business-audience word ban (Agents 101 default).
rules_evaluated.evidence: No unearned tech vocabulary. This is AE101 (engineer audience); no jargon misalignments.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Memory vs context — use deliberately.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No confusions between memory and context in body prose.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Golden path only in body — THIS RULE HAS AN EXCEPTION.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No troubleshooting branches in body. Forward-moving narrative throughout.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Trust Claude's defaults for structure.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Prompts specify shape only where teaching moment depends on it. No over-specification.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Q1/Q2/Q3 retro interview is banned at every module.
rules_evaluated.evidence: M5 exercise, not module file; rule does not apply.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle another module's voice.
rules_evaluated.evidence: M5 voice consistent throughout. No borrowed voice from other modules.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't ask student to manually diff or spot-check Claude's output as error-catching.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 44 delegates to Claude for showing quotes. Instructions name clear actors and mechanisms.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Simulation personas never alone.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Exercise does not include self-study simulation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No "What research says" callout boxes.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No callout boxes in student-facing body. Citations are inline or below fence.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Student moves stay in conversation with agent.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All actions are prompts or inline judgment. No terminal commands or editor operations outside conversation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Specify which CLAUDE.md layer — every time.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No CLAUDE.md references in student-facing body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No em-dashes. Simple sentences.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -E '—' body = zero hits. All sentences short and direct.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Section headers use command verbs when section is about doing something.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Phase headers are declarative (naming arc). Internal sections use verbs where action described.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Inline links use target's title, never filename.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 123: [What packaging is](lectures/what-packaging-is.md) uses title, not filename.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Disambiguate shared-word collisions with Claude Code primitives on first student-authored use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Terms using properly. No collisions with Claude Code primitives in body prose.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: LLM-vs-agent-vs-Claude vocabulary discipline.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Terminology correct: agent for autonomous work, Claude for addressee. No conflations.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Session / task / run split (all trainings).
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 5: Session (new). Task context follows. Run used only in historical context (M4 run). Terms correct per vocabulary.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No time-of-day anchors in body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -E 'tomorrow|overnight|this morning|tonight|next morning|yesterday|last night' = zero hits. Timing session-relative.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Reflection beats stay invisible in flow.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No reflection-beat headers or contemplative-pause prefixes. Reflection embedded in action.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No meta-ask when student has already decided.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No meta-loops asking student to re-declare decisions. Instructions flow directly to next prompt.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: `.md` is default file type for student artifacts across curriculum.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 87: plan.md (default .md format used).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cut NVA: true but not moving student forward.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Every sentence advances phase or teaches mechanism. No NVA implementation details or asides. Lean structure.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Body "read it" / "look at it" / "notice X" after chat-print = dead weight.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No generic read/look instructions after prompts. Body moves to next action, not narration.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forward-callout closer: student as grammatical subject.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No forward-looking asides in body. Subject test would pass if any existed.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Operational reminders live at moment of use, not only where introduced.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Worktree location at line 7, reaffirmed at line 117 for Phase 5. Reminders at moments of use.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Echo the training's theory spine before inventing a synonym.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Vocabulary uses training frames: verifier, reference, plan.md from M5 theory. No invented synonyms.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Name the artifact, not the act.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Ask Claude treatment throughout. Prompt is the noun. No typing/saying/telling described.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Name the outcome; don't walk a professional through trivial mechanics.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No terminal recipes. Outcomes named clearly. Setup delegated to Claude where appropriate.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: The curriculum does not narrate itself.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No arc-positioning sentences. Body stays on student's work. No self-description of exercise structure.
